terminal app entrypoint and top-level composition shell.
app-level composition boundaries (platform, domain, and controller wiring) that join environment adapters with feature hooks.
transport lifecycle, runtime boot/IO bridge, and connection state projection.

environment contracts shared by app bootstrap and controller layers.
terminal command contract + registry ownership (UI actions and shortcut mapping).
shared terminal contracts (session + transport types and ready-state constants).
platform-facing utilities shared by app/engine bindings (for example scheduler abstractions).
presentational controls, status bar, and session menu UI.
UI-facing formatting and presenter mapping for menu/session copy.
floating-controls registry, metadata, and descriptor assembly.
session payload parsing and candidate derivation.
storage adapters and storage key ownership.
protocol parsing owned by the terminal feature.
transport adapters owned by the terminal feature.
xterm runtime loading owned by the terminal feature.
